Overview

Szombathely is a city in Vas with a population of 78,884. Hungary’s oldest recorded city, founded by the Romans as Savaria, with well-preserved Roman ruins, a charming main square, and a vibrant cultural scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
